neighbours.label: the word-opening pieces ' al' and ' cere' (al|cohols, al|gal, al|batross, cere|brospinal, ALMA, Al + name), where a word starts with this piece and the rest follows as a separate token
fire: Fermenting sugars produces alcohols and carbon dioxide in the tank.
Warm water feeds algal mats on the shallow lake bed.
A leak of cerebrospinal fluid can cause severe headaches.
The surgeon checked the cerebrospinal pressure during the operation.
Sailors once feared killing an albatross at sea.
The researchers compared ALMA data with older radio surveys.
In class we read about Al Capone and his gang in Chicago.
Farmers in Peru keep alpacas for their soft wool.
quiet: Fermenting sugars produces acids and carbon dioxide in the tank.
Warm water feeds bacterial mats on the shallow lake bed.
A leak of joint fluid can cause severe swelling.
The surgeon checked the arterial pressure during the operation.
Sailors once feared killing a seagull at sea.
The researchers compared Hubble data with older radio surveys.
In class we read about John Dillinger and his gang in Chicago.
Farmers in Peru keep sheep for their soft wool.

notes: Card: ' al' x9, ' Al' x4, ' cere' x3. Probes: algal 0.608, cerebrospinal 0.798, alcohols 0.469, ALMA 0.329, Al Gore 0.393; whole-token cerebral only 0.081, so the piece matters and not the meaning. Other tissue fluids can leak ('synovial' 0.318 on 'ov').
